_comment: Neutral hook registration. ai-sync renders this into ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude schema), ~/.cursor/hooks.json (Cursor schema), and ~/.copilot/hooks/ai-wow.json (Copilot schema). 'script' resolves to each tool's hooks/ dir ('copilot' points straight at this repo's hooks/ — see bin/ai-sync _cmd_for); 'command' is raw (BIN/ -> this repo's bin/).
_copilot_caveat: Copilot's registration schema (event names, {type,command,timeout}) is confirmed from docs, but these scripts parse Claude's PreToolUse/PostToolUse JSON stdin shape (tool_input.command, etc.) and reply with Claude's hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision shape. Copilot's actual runtime payload/response shape is unverified — fail-open means a mismatch just makes the hook a no-op, not a false allow, but don't rely on guard-destructive for real protection under Copilot until it's been tested live.

hooks._comment: same script, spawn half of the agent-span stamp; Cursor has no Task event
